title: Be Strong, and Work
old_p1: The people were building the Lord’s house again. Some old people remembered the first one. It had been big and beautiful.
The Lord asked, “How does this new house look to you? Like nothing?” It looked so small next to the first one.
So the Lord sent Haggai with a message: “Be strong, all you people, and work. For I am with you.”
old_p2: The Lord said, “My Spirit is with you. Do not be afraid.” The Spirit is the Lord’s quiet help in our hearts. He promised, “In this place I will give peace.”
When a job feels too big, the Lord is with you too. Tonight, make strong arms. You can be brave, because the Lord is with you.
p1: The people were building the Lord’s house again. Some old people remembered the first one, so big and beautiful.
“How does this house look to you now?” the Lord asked. “Like nothing?” Next to the first one, it looked so small.
So Heavenly Father sent Haggai with a message. “Be strong, all you people, and work,” said the Lord. “For I am with you.”
p2: The Lord said, “My Spirit stays with you. Fear not.” He promised this house would be even greater than the first. “In this place I will give peace.”
When a job feels too big, the Lord is with you too. Tonight, make strong arms and say, “I can keep going!”
